---
title: "brain summary"
format: html
---

I am  finding the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain - that is, the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus - regions in human, pig and mouse.

```{r}
total_elevated_human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print (total_elevated_human)
```

```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print (total_elevated_mouse)
```

```{r}
total_elevated_pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print (total_elevated_pig)
```

Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
